Title: Fix Pulse Console Accept and Decline bridge
Problem / Request: The Builder failed because PULSE-034 was marked READY before exact patches existed. Add the smallest working bridge now: requested rides in the Pulse Console RIDES view receive secure Accept and Decline actions that open the existing standalone request app, which remains the only writer and continues its existing email and Calendar results.
Acceptance Criteria: Four reviewed exact patches are staged. Pulse Console reads requested rides from the shared DEV Ride Requests sheet and generates action-specific expiring HMAC Accept and Decline links compatible with the standalone request app. Accept opens the existing confirm flow, which updates the one request row, sends the customer confirmation, and creates the existing Calendar event. Decline opens the existing decline flow and sends its existing rider update. Runtime never writes Ride Requests, sends rider email, or creates Calendar events. mode=test uses example.invalid links and makes no writes. The build opens a reviewed pull request only; no merge, deployment, authorization, production data, fare, payment, or automatic dispatch.
